paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved +1.50% on average, with Nasdaq strongest (+6.45%) and Nikkei 225 weakest (-5.06%). Brent crude changed -5.19% to 87.77. Gold changed +4.43% to 3,671.2. Bitcoin changed +2.86% to 62,911.3281. The US 10-year yield stands at 4.952%, a relative move of +0.81%. Among the firms tracked, Freeport-McMoRan (+7.83%) and Lazard (+6.79%) moved the most.
